$comment: Images of the live site (WordPress export docs/cambridgehospital.WordPress.2026-10-06.xml, attachment URLs) that would fill a placeholder or an empty image slot here. The export carries URLs only and wp-content/uploads sits behind a Cloudflare bot check (403 to scripts, NW1): download with `node tools/download-news-images.mjs --browser --headed` (fetches these too, into src/assets/<key>.<ext>) or copy the uploads folder from Pramod. After the download, point the JSON named in `usedBy` at `key` (and crop / box values for insurer logos). Group `conditions` is wired (bug 042, 9 Oct 2026: saved through a real Chrome with the user's approval into docs/cambridge-images-conditions, composed by tools/condition-banners/run.sh). The other groups are not: the site keeps the Figma photos until then.
